item.title: 2026.07.28.00e7803
item.description:
Account management + live menu bar + reliability fixes

  • Switch accounts in Settings → Accounts — per-account usage, Promote, rename/delete inline.
  • Menu-bar readout (opt-in) — active account's usage % and/or a countdown to the next refresh.
  • "Re-login needed" + Re-link — expired logins are flagged and re-captured from a fresh claude login, no duplicate.
  • Claude engine status — Settings ▸ General shows the detected claude path + version (or why it won't run).
  • Token-billed accounts read "No plan usage · token-billed"; extra-credits allowance now shows.

Fixed — no more duplicated usage bars. A running claude session holds the shared macOS login, so a background usage probe could report its numbers for other accounts (two accounts showing identical bars). tokenbank now detects a live session and pauses the background account polls — keeping last-known usage and showing “Paused · a Claude session is running” — instead of risking a wrong reading. The active account keeps refreshing, and normal polling resumes once no session is running.

Fixed — stored logins can no longer be cross-contaminated. A running session could previously cause one account's saved credential to be overwritten with another's during a poll (two accounts ending up on the same login). That capture is now skipped while a session is running, so each account keeps its own credential.

Fixed: sessions no longer drop (the heartbeat never refreshes your active login); a dead-token account is marked "Re-login needed" instead of borrowing another's usage; account switching reliably keeps the freshest token; OAuth tokens are never logged.

Fixed: a false "app is behind the daemon" version-mismatch banner on fresh installs (thanks to The Persian Prince for the catch).

Updates: now checks hourly (was daily), and same-day releases are offered correctly.

Diagnostics & polish: usage-poll failures log a clear reason instead of failing silently; usage rows align cleanly (fixed-width % and resets-in columns).

Requires macOS 14+ and Claude Code.

item.description:
Automatic updates are here

First release with built-in updates — tokenbank now updates itself in place.

  • New: Automatic updates (Sparkle). Background checks and one-click install, cryptographically signed. Manual check in Settings → General → Check Now.
  • Fixed: Settings window (General / Accounts / Log) no longer opens cramped or clipped, sizes correctly, and shows a proper title.

Signed (Developer ID: Archaitect B.V.) and notarized. Requires macOS 14+ and Claude Code.
